thread:
Noah Vega: Short owner-lock for the metering postmortem actions. Root cause: delayed token ingest -> burst replay -> invoice mismatches. Please reply with owner + ETA.

Noah Vega: Actions: fix consumer retry behavior, run ledger backfill, tag & correct invoices, publish credit policy, add alerts, run a 14-day audit.

Anika Rao: I'll take the consumer patch. Found DB write timeouts caused retry amplification. Implementing capped retries + DLQ + jitter. Canary tomorrow AM, full rollout by end of week.

Theo Park: I'll own the backfill execution and runbook. Will run a staging dry-run on 15 accounts tonight and emit a reconciliation CSV. Prod backfill scheduled Sat 00:30-04:30 UTC. ETA: dry-run tonight, prod Sat window.

CS Lead: I'll draft customer comms and credit rules. Proposal: auto-apply credits when corrected delta > $100; $25-$100 queue to CS for review; enterprise tier gets automatic 100% credit. Will post templates tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Incident MET-2025-03-28 recorded as TKT-7333. Linked PRs for fixes & alerts. Backfill window scheduled Sat 00:30-04:30 UTC.

Anika Rao: Alerts: added metering.ingest.backlog.p95 and metering.consumer.error_rate; thresholds trigger eng-oncall and a short runbook. PRs merged.

Noah Vega: Finance asks: tag corrected invoices with memo "metering-correction TKT-7333" and add a separate "metering adjustment" line item. Include original invoice ID, corrected amount, and delta in the CSV.

Theo Park: Dry-run complete, uploaded CSV to the ticket. Samples look good; checksums match. I'll post pre-check list and rollback steps before the prod run.

CS Lead: Received CSV, will prepare templated messages and include an opt-out for invoice reissue vs credit. Will coordinate on threshold edge cases.

Noah Vega: Recurrence check: Anika, can you run a 45-day scan for similar ingestion spikes and paste a short summary? If >2 occurrences escalate to infra changes.

Anika Rao: Running now. Preliminary: one small spike two weeks ago. Full chart by EOD; will recommend DB write rate-limits if we see more.

Noah Vega: Owners & ETAs summary:
- Consumer patch: Anika  canary tomorrow AM, rollout end of week
- Backfill & runbook: Theo  dry-run done, prod Sat 00:30 UTC
- Invoice tags & credits: CS Lead + Finance  templates tomorrow, corrections Sat after backfill
- Alerts & runbook: Anika  merged
- 14-day rolling audit: Noah to kick off after backfill

Theo Park: Will ping when prod backfill starts and when complete.

Noah Vega: Thanks team  I will update the postmortem tracker and we can close once corrections and the 14-day audit are complete. :white_check_mark:
